Kim, thanks — good call. Confirming numbers below (conservative baseline for procurement):

- Conservative monthly tokens: 75,000,000 tokens/month (this is after dedup/caching assumptions).
- Typical baseline TPS: 45 TPS (US region, business hours)
- Peak TPS: 220 TPS for up to 40 minutes, ~3x/week during promotional pushes.
- Average output tokens per request: ~320 tokens; average input tokens ~80 tokens (so ~400 tokens total request).

On unit economics — we're targeting a target cost of no more than $18 / 1M tokens for the committed band (this is a stretch target from finance). If commit pricing is closer to $14–$16 / 1M at scale, that'll get internal approval faster.

I attached a simple forecast (Neurolytics-usage-forecast.xlsx) that shows month-by-month ramp (0–9 months) and our expected burst cadence.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you need clarification.

Jared — quick technical notes matching the numbers you provided:

- Peak planning: 220 TPS peak at ~400 tokens/request => ~88k tokens/sec. That fits on our Dedicated pools but requires autoscale headroom (burst instances) to keep p99 latency targets under 250ms for streaming.
- KV cache: if you can cache session prefixes (~25% of token churn), that reduces effective token load to ~56k tokens/sec during peaks.
- Recommendation: prefer the medium-context (context ~2k) model variant we demoed; it gives comparable quality with ~15% lower compute than large-context variants for your prompt lengths.
- Concurrency guidance: aim for <= 6 outstanding requests per user to avoid queueing; we'll model burst policies in the quote.

I'll add these assumptions into the proposal draft so the pricing band accounts for autoscale costs and peak reserve.

— Karthik
Sr Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Pricing bands and recommended commit structure (Neurolytics)

Hi Jared — based on Kim and Karthik's inputs, here are two pragmatic options for procurement: 

Option A — Committed 12-month (preferred)
- Commit: 75M tokens/month
- Price: $14 / 1M tokens (effective)
- Burst headroom: +2x for short windows (additional overage at $9 / 1M tokens)
- SLA: 99.9% uptime, priority support, monthly usage report

Option B — PAYG with volume discount
- No commit; PAYG base: $22 / 1M tokens
- After 100M tokens in a month: discounted to $16 / 1M for tokens beyond slab
- No SLA upgrade unless committed

Notes: the committed price gets you close to Jared's target $/1M. If you can commit to a 6-month minimum we can split the difference ($15 / 1M) and add 1 reserved burst day per month free.

Next steps: 
- If Option A looks good, we need an internal PO and signature; I'll prepare a redline-friendly term sheet.
- If you want the 6-month compromise ($15 / 1M), I'll send a revised term sheet today for signature.

Can you confirm which option you prefer? Also confirm whether Neurolytics requires SOC 2 evidence and whether you need VPC/private deployment for production traffic (that impacts lead time).

Thanks — Marissa
Commercial Lead | Redwood Inference
